source_notes: Algorithm 1 assigns tau < K1/2 to Phase I and K1/2 <= tau < K1 to Phase II.
Section 4 prose says Phase I performs K1 iterations while naming the K1/2 iterate; this is recorded as a source inconsistency.
Theorem 5.1 and Corollary 5.3 are conditional, high-probability asymptotic bounds rather than finite-instance equalities.
Theorem 5.4 bounds transfer excess risk by a representation term plus sigma^2 k / K2 under Assumptions 3.2 and 3.3.
